review.why: Writes director, VP, C-suite and board resumes that separate scope, personal ownership and governance service.
review.summary: Asks for the target role, organization scale and what the candidate was hired to change, then keeps apart revenue, budget and P&L, direct reports and total organization, and board seats, advisory work and board presentations. Each appointment gets a scope line, selected decisions and outcomes, with verbs that do not credit the executive with everything.
strengths: Table of distinctions that executives commonly blur
Worked example with the claim to avoid
Protects nonpublic financials and unreleased transactions
cautions: Instructions only: no templates or scripts
Confidential figures may limit what the user can supply
